description: Turn a launch into an X (Twitter) post or a numbered thread. Returns posts, each with text, weighted_length (twitter-text parseTweet: 280 max, URLs count as 23, emoji and CJK count extra) and intent_url (https://x.com/intent/post) that opens the composer prefilled. It does not call X, sign in, or post. mode single (default) is one post and refuses over 280; mode thread splits on sentence or word boundaries and numbers posts like 1/3. tone is excited (default), plain, technical, or casual.

hashtags.description: Optional tags, with or without a leading #. One tag per item.

mode.description: single (default) writes one post. thread splits and numbers when the draft is longer than 280.

project.description: Project name, as it should read in the post

shipped.description: What shipped, in plain text. This is the body of the post.

tone.description: Voice of the opening line. Default excited.

url.description: Live URL of the project, http or https. Counted as 23 characters when X recognizes it.

name: draft_x_launch_post
title: Draft an X launch post
